name: hunt_dm_noise15_ny

source.title: Claude hunt 2026-10-20 (designer: momentum / displacement / breakouts on a close): the noise-band breakout on NQ 15-minute closes, both sides, every NY pass. Why it should pay: a move away from the 09:30 open larger than 0.3 x the daily ATR, with price on the same side of the day's VWAP, is one-way participation (trend followers, dealers hedging short gamma, late institutional orders) that keeps being chased, while moves inside the band are the noise that market makers fade. Who loses: the mean-reversion traders and market makers who sell a move beyond the day's normal noise (buy the drop) and are stopped out as it extends.

entry.words: Mark the 09:30 ET open. The band is the open +/- 0.3 x the daily ATR(14) of the days before, fixed for the day; the VWAP runs from 09:30. A 15-minute bar that closes above the upper band AND above the VWAP is a long at the next bar's open; closes below the lower band AND below the VWAP, a short. Stop 40 points, target 60 points (1:1.5). One trade per session pass (nyam 09:30-11:00, mid 11:00-13:30, pm 13:30-15:58): up to three a day, flat 15:58.

taught: [noise.py docstring: Zarattini / Aziz / Barbon (2024) noise-area intraday momentum; Matteo Conti's vault break, IQCapital A0G14JYYVTk] a close beyond the open +/- k x A with price on the VWAP's side is followed
[family default and Conti's own value] k 0.3 of the daily ATR(14) (the library ran 0.2 / 0.3 / 0.4); not tuned

[Claude hunt 2026-10-20] the rth anchor (the 09:30 open and the VWAP from 09:30), both sides, 15-minute closes (the house's bar where NQ rules have held), one trade per NY pass, a fixed 40 / 60 point bracket (1:1.5, the hunt's centre)

[prior knowledge, read before designing: WHAT_WORKS.md 2026-10-20] the globex-anchored long-only mid version (nq_noise_gx_mid_long, 1m, 30 / 3R) is the only rule that ever passed an unseen read and the random gate (retired form); noise_pm_long_v2 lost unseen; no rth-anchored both-sided 15-minute sheet has run
not_run: THE BAND: the papers' noise boundary is the average absolute move from the open at that minute over the last 14 days; the family's band is fixed for the day at k x the daily ATR(14) (Conti's form).
THE EXIT: the papers exit on a VWAP / boundary trailing stop or at the close; the engine runs the fixed 40 / 60 point bracket instead.
THE GRID: the papers decide every 30 minutes; here every 15-minute close.
STATE, NOT EVENT: at the first close of the mid and pm passes (11:15, 13:45) a price that is already beyond the band enters at once (the papers' rule is a state too).

THE CAP IS PER SESSION PASS, NOT PER DAY: max_trades 1 counts inside each of the 3 passes, so a day can hold up to 3 trades; the passes are independent instances, so a trade of one pass may still be open when the next pass enters (one position at a time holds inside a pass only; the hunt's stack step applies one-at-a-time across legs).

THE FAMILY'S MONTHS: the globex-anchored long-only noise sheets had unseen reads and a block walk-forward (nq_noise_gx_mid_long): this sheet's anchor, sides and bar differ, but the family's test months are partly seen.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage on market and stop fills, $4 a round turn, tick replay, 1 NQ).
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on an equity half day); no entry in the last 5 minutes of a pass.
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ by this sheet: build days only (2021-09-22 .. 2025-06-30); the 3:1 block walk-forward is a separate, pre-registered read (hunt PREREG Gate 2).
